checklist.why: Workflow-state job; names ConditionTag, Banner and row text for a forecast
Both lists present; alternatives exist in the library
Chip, word, dot, line anatomy named and drawn
Word and Dot are used by no screen (Dot's README says so)
States table per variant; none-states give reasons
Not a target; host rows measure 76-88px
One chip per row; urgency order stated
Chip, word and line always carry the word; the colour-only Dot is gated (see variant)
12 / 6 character cap, wrap not ellipsis, long and zh examples
Live region rule, aria-hidden icon, port notes
Separator now var(--space-4); CSS-variable list given; only a 1px hairline is raw
Related table and Classification section present
All kinds and variants render at 375px with no overflow (scrollWidth 375)

variants.name: Chip
findings: Map holds on Farrowing (Active blue, Done green+check, Sow died red) and the pen list (To do muted, Late amber+clock, Done green+check); every chip carries its word
Home passes a timing count ('Day 2 of 7') with icon 'clock', which the map reserves for Late; the README says a count is not a Status
The tagged-piglets page uses the chip for 'Breeder', an attribute, not a state

variants.name: Word
findings: No screen uses it; Farrowing's Go-to-pen map still hand-colours its state words (.pen-cell.active green)

variants.name: Dot
findings: Done, Late, Overdue and Sow died are all solid dots: same shape, only colour differs

variants.name: Line
findings: Farrowing builds 'Overdue · 3 days' by regex-injecting <span class="st-part" data-tone="red"> (farrowing-astra-concept.js:236) instead of calling statusLine()

findings.text: Farrowing's Go-to-pen map paints pen states by hand and off the map: .pen-cell.active small is green (map: active = progress blue), .late red, .due amber; penFact() codes 'Overdue' as kind 'late' (farrowing-astra-room.css:10, farrowing-astra-concept.js:248).
findings.fix: Render the pen-cell state with SentriUI.status({ variant: 'word', kind }) and map Overdue to kind 'overdue'; delete the .pen-cell.<kind> small colours.

findings.text: Home's task card puts a timing count in a Status chip with the Late clock icon ('Day 2 of 7' blue, 'Day 3 of 7' muted), so the clock means two things.
findings.fix: Drop icon:'clock' at astra-home-task-card.js:24, or make the timing plain meta text; a count is not a Status.

findings.text: Word and Dot still have no screen (line 4); Dot tells Done/Late/Overdue/Died apart by colour alone.
findings.fix: Put Word on the pen map (first finding) and remove Dot from the library until a screen needs it.

findings.text: Farrowing's overdue line hand-writes the statusLine markup via regex.
findings.fix: Build it with SentriUI.statusLine([[{ text: 'Overdue' }, { text: '3 days', tone: 'red' }]]).

findings.text: 'Breeder' on the tagged-piglets row is an attribute shown as a state chip.
findings.fix: Show it as row meta or by the bookmark state it already has; keep the chip for workflow states.

verdicts.finding: Status used by no screen; three hand-built chip implementations
verdicts.note: TaskRow, Farrowing and Home call status({ variant: 'chip' }); .tk-chip, .state-word/.done-word/.ended-word, .hc-status deleted. Residual: Farrowing pen-map colours.
To do is awaiting/muted rgb(101,112,96) on the pen list and sheet
